text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, I shared a 
proposed schedule adjustment with Ikuno 
Dictus, and—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry, my thoughts just... won't 
focus... This... won't do, will it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My apologies, but we shall 
continue this tomorrow. I must attend to 
recovering from race fatigue immediately.

It seems fatigue has built up more than 
anticipated. We should review the schedule 
once.
